What air duct cleaning actually does

Your HVAC system moves a lot of air. Over time, particles can settle inside the ductwork and around supply vents and returns. Air duct cleaning focuses on the pathways that air travels through, and it often pairs well with ongoing care like Air Duct Maintenance in La Jolla Shores, CA.

A typical duct cleaning visit targets

  • Supply ducts that deliver air to each room
  • Return ducts that pull air back to the system
  • Vent openings and grilles
  • The main trunk lines where buildup often collects

If you have ever pulled a vent cover off and thought, Well, that explains the dust, you are not alone. La Jolla Shores homes near the beach can see sand and fine particles work their way inside. Will air duct cleaning help with dust and airflow

It can help, depending on what is causing the issue. Duct cleaning removes material that is already inside the ductwork. If dust is mainly coming from open windows, older door seals, or heavy foot traffic from the beach, you will still see dust. You just may be starting from a cleaner duct system.

Airflow can also be affected by things that cleaning does not change, like duct design, crushed flex duct, closed dampers, or undersized returns.
